papers.title: MCMC for Variationally Sparse Gaussian Processes
papers.abstract: Gaussian process (GP) models form a core part of probabilistic machine learning. Considerable research effort has been made into attacking three issues with GP models: how to compute efficiently when the number of data is large; how to approximate the posterior when the likelihood is not Gaussian and how to estimate covariance function parameter posteriors. This paper simultaneously addresses these, using a variational approximation to the posterior which is sparse in support of the function but otherwise free-form. The result is a Hybrid Monte-Carlo sampling scheme which allows for a non-Gaussian approximation over the function values and covariance parameters simultaneously, with efficient computations based on inducing-point sparse GPs. Code to replicate each experiment in this paper will be available shortly.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了结合变分推断和MCMC的高斯过程后验近似方法，适用于替代建模中的不确定性量化，但未涉及有限元或生物力学应用。
llm.why_not_core: Does not apply to FEA surrogate modeling, no constraints handling, and lacks validation on engineering or biomechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高大规模高斯过程模型的计算效率和后验近似精度
summary_zh.method: 提出变分稀疏近似下的混合蒙特卡洛采样，同时近似函数和协方差参数后验
summary_zh.result: 在多个数据集上比标准稀疏GP获得更准确的后验近似
summary_zh.validation: 在UCI回归和分类基准数据集上数值实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve computational efficiency and posterior approximation accuracy for Gaussian process models with large datasets and non-Gaussian likelihoods.
summary_en.method: A hybrid Monte Carlo sampling scheme is developed using a variational sparse approximation to jointly sample function values and covariance parameters.
summary_en.result: The method provides more accurate posterior approximations than standard sparse GPs on several datasets.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on UCI regression and classification benchmarks.

papers.title: On the role of melt flow into the surface structure and porosity development during selective laser melting
papers.abstract: In this study, the development of surface structure and porosity of Ti–6Al–4V samples fabricated by selective laser melting under different laser scanning speeds and powder layer thicknesses has been studied and correlated with the melt flow behaviour through both experimental and modelling approaches. The as-fabricated samples were investigated using optical microscopy (OM) and scanning electron microscopy (SEM). The interaction between laser beam and powder particles was studied by both high speed imaging observation and computational fluid dynamics (CFD) calculation. It was found that at a high laser power and a fixed powder layer thickness (20 μm), the samples contain particularly low porosity when the laser scanning speeds are below 2700 mm/s. Further increase of scanning speed led to increase of porosity but not significantly. The porosity is even more sensitive to powder layer thickness with the use of thick powder layers (above 40 μm) leading to significant porosity. The increase of porosity with laser scanning speed and powder layer thickness is not inconsistent with the observed increase in surface roughness complicated by increasingly irregular-shaped laser scanned tracks and an increased number of discontinuity and cave-like pores on the top surfaces. The formation of pores and development of rough surfaces were found by both high speed imaging and modelling, to be strongly associated with unstable melt flow and splashing of molten material.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM工艺参数对钛合金孔隙率和表面粗糙度的影响，但未涉及力学性能测试或生物医学植入物相关评价。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not include mechanical testing (static or fatigue), stress shielding analysis, or osseointegration assessment, and does not link porous structures to implant performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 理解熔体流动对选区激光熔化表面结构和孔隙率的影响
summary_zh.method: 结合高速成像和CFD模拟研究不同工艺参数下的熔体行为
summary_zh.result: 孔隙率和表面粗糙度与不稳定熔体流动和飞溅密切相关
summary_zh.validation: 通过高速成像和CFD模拟验证熔体流动行为

summary_en.motivation: To understand how melt flow influences surface structure and porosity development in selective laser melting of Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: Experimental high-speed imaging and computational fluid dynamics (CFD) modeling were used to correlate process parameters with melt flow behavior.
summary_en.result: Porosity and surface roughness increase with scanning speed and layer thickness, driven by unstable melt flow and splashing.
summary_en.validation: High-speed imaging and CFD simulations were employed to validate the observed melt flow phenomena.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是用于航空航天的Inconel 718合金，而非生物医用植入物，不涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或骨整合。
llm.why_not_core: Does not address biomedical implant context, contains no porous structure design or stress shielding analysis, and lacks fatigue testing relevant to implant conditions.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究标准热处理对SLM制造Inconel 718合金微观结构和力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 对SLM成形的Inconel 718进行标准热处理，分析微观组织并测试力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 热处理细化微观组织，提高了抗拉强度和硬度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸和硬度实验进行力学性能验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of standard heat treatment on the microstructure and mechanical properties of selective laser melted Inconel 718 superalloy.
summary_en.method: Standard heat treatment was applied to SLM-fabricated Inconel 718 specimens, followed by microstructural characterization and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment refined the microstructure and improved tensile strength and hardness.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing including tensile and hardness measurements.
